title: Navimower 0.4.4-beta18

## Ellipsoid migration fix

- Keep the beta17 WGS84 ellipsoid metre conversion, but also migrate persisted georeference state so old spherical fits cannot survive an upgrade and contaminate fresh diagnostics.
- Mark every newly active transform and learned calibration with `geodesy_model: wgs84_ellipsoid_v1`.
- On the first startup with an older persisted map cache, discard only derived absolute georeference state (`georeference`, learned calibration and normalized vendor reference), preserve the local map geometry, and force one fresh map-detail decode.
- Clear obsolete X3/ETRS probe markers tied to the discarded derived reference so the rebuilt map can pass through the current vendor/static/X3 candidate pipeline cleanly.

## Why beta18 follows beta17 immediately

- beta17 correctly changed the live metre conversion and disabled the automatic beta16 ETRS89 shift, but an existing installation could still restore a fit learned with the old spherical maths.
- beta18 closes that migration gap before we collect the next H2/i1/i2/X3 raw data set.

## Field test / raw data

- Update to beta18 rather than beta17 before collecting new raw exports.
- After the first reload/startup, allow the mower to move over a useful spatial baseline so cloud XY/GPS fitting can rebuild with the WGS84 ellipsoid model.
- Export fresh raw data after the fit has collected movement samples. Docked exports remain useful for local-frame checks, but moving/wide-baseline exports are the priority for the next georeference comparison.
